grounding.name: a plain answer with the delay, costs and a pick
grounding.answer:
SHIP-421 is projected to arrive 12 hours late. Waiting costs $0 and leaves ORD-421 12 h late; rerouting costs $80 and is 3 h late; splitting costs $120 and is on time.
Recommended plan: {id:split-express}

Ship the 12 laptops in Arequipa stock (ready Oct 12, 10:00) and send the other 8 units express, arriving Oct 12, 1:00 PM, before the 2026-10-12T14:00:00-05:00 promise. All 20 units are covered.
Recommended plan: {id:split-express}

grounding.answer:
Nothing on hand reaches Cusco in time: 12 critical units at risk for ORD-433A, and 18 units for ORD-433B. The carrier itself is 24 h late. Flying the 12 tablets and rebooking the other 18 costs $390; the store order waits 8 h.
Recommended plan: {id:priority-air-ground}

grounding.answer:
Trujillo has 30 laptops, ready Oct 13, 08:00. ORD-460 (hospital, 20 units) is served first; ORD-461 (school, 25 units) gets the other 10 and 15 more by express transfer, arriving Oct 13, 8:00 PM, for $300.
Recommended plan: {id:express-transfer}
